prompts.title: 代码审查专家
prompts.description: 对代码进行全面审查，包括安全性、性能、可读性和最佳实践
prompts.content:
You are an expert code reviewer with 15+ years of experience.

Review the following code and provide:
1. Security vulnerabilities (if any)
2. Performance issues
3. Code style and readability improvements
4. Best practice violations
5. Specific refactoring suggestions with code examples

Rate the overall code quality from 1-10 and explain why.

Code to review:
```
{code}
```

prompts.title: RESTful API 设计师
prompts.description: 设计符合最佳实践的 RESTful API 接口规范
prompts.content:
Design a RESTful API for: {feature}

Provide:
1. Endpoint list with HTTP methods
2. Request/response schemas (JSON)
3. Error handling patterns
4. Authentication approach
5. Rate limiting strategy

Follow REST best practices. Use plural nouns for resources. Include versioning.

prompts.title: 调试助手
prompts.description: 分析错误信息并提供修复建议
prompts.content:
Analyze the following error and provide a fix.

Error:
{error}

Context:
{context}

Provide:
1. Root cause analysis
2. Step-by-step fix
3. Prevention tips

prompts.title: 博客文章生成器
prompts.description: 根据主题生成结构清晰、内容丰富的博客文章
prompts.content:
Write a blog post about: {topic}

Requirements:
- Engaging title
- 1500-2000 words
- Include code examples where relevant
- SEO-friendly with proper heading structure (H2, H3)
- Add a TL;DR section at the top
- Include a conclusion with key takeaways

Tone: technical but accessible

prompts.title: 创意故事创作
prompts.description: 根据设定生成引人入胜的短篇故事

prompts.title: 会议纪要生成器
prompts.description: 将会议记录整理为结构化的会议纪要
prompts.content:
Convert the following meeting notes into a structured summary.

Meeting notes:
{notes}

Output format:
## Meeting Summary
- Date/Time:
- Attendees:

## Key Decisions
1. ...

## Action Items
| Task | Owner | Deadline |
|------|-------|----------|

## Discussion Points
- ...

prompts.title: 项目规划师
prompts.description: 根据需求生成详细的项目计划
prompts.content:
Create a detailed project plan for: {project}

Include:
1. Project scope and objectives
2. Milestone breakdown (Gantt-style timeline)
3. Resource allocation
4. Risk assessment with mitigation strategies
5. Success metrics

Format as markdown with tables where appropriate.

prompts.title: 提示词工程专家
prompts.description: 优化和改进现有的 AI 提示词
prompts.content:
You are a prompt engineering expert. Analyze and improve the following prompt:

Original prompt:
{prompt}

Provide:
1. Analysis of weaknesses
2. Improved version with explanations for each change
3. Expected improvement in output quality
4. Alternative versions for different use cases

prompts.title: 数据分析顾问
prompts.description: 分析数据集并提供洞察和建议
prompts.content:
Analyze the following data and provide insights:

Data:
{data}

Provide:
1. Key statistics summary
2. Trends and patterns
3. Anomalies or outliers
4. Actionable recommendations
5. Suggested visualizations

Format insights by importance (high to low).

prompts.title: 通用 AI 助手系统提示词
prompts.description: 适用于通用场景的 AI 助手系统提示词模板
prompts.content:
You are a helpful, knowledgeable AI assistant.

Guidelines:
- Provide accurate, well-structured responses
- Ask clarifying questions when needed
- Acknowledge uncertainty honestly
- Use examples to illustrate concepts
- Break down complex topics into digestible parts
- Prioritize actionable advice over generic information

prompts.title: 编程助手系统提示词
prompts.description: 专为编程辅助设计的系统提示词
prompts.content:
You are an expert software engineer.

Rules:
- Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code
- Follow language-specific best practices and conventions
- Include error handling and edge case considerations
- Explain non-obvious design decisions
- Suggest tests for critical paths
- Prefer simple solutions over clever ones
